title: Disentangling Perceptions of Offensiveness: Cultural and Moral Correlates

bias_targets.methodology: Collecting offensiveness annotations from participants across 8 distinct geo-cultural regions (21 countries) and evaluating how well Jigsaw dataset labels and Perspective API model predictions correlate with the majority votes from each specific region to demonstrate preferential cultural alignment.

Administering the Moral Foundations Questionnaire to annotators and using regression analysis to calculate the extent to which Perspective API model predictions systematically align with annotators who score higher on specific moral foundations, such as 'Care'.
